topic: Telling a Story: An Unexpected Event

scenarios.scenario: A small accident on the way to school
scenarios.context: A student tells what happened this morning.

speakerA.en: Why are you late today, Omid?
Oh no! Are you hurt?
What did you do?
That was kind of him. You should be more careful next time.

speakerB.en: You won't believe it. I had a small accident on my bike.
Only a little. I was riding fast and a dog suddenly ran across the road.
I tried to avoid it, but I fell. Luckily, a man helped me stand up.
I know. From now on, I'll ride slowly near the school.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk about a power cut.

speakerA.en: Did you hear? The lights went out during our exam yesterday.
At first, everybody was surprised and nobody spoke.
She told us to stay calm. Ten minutes later, the power came back.
Yes, she gave us extra time. It was strange, but it turned out fine.

speakerB.en: Yes, I was in the other room. What did your teacher do?
Then what happened?
Did you finish the exam?
I'm glad. Unexpected things can be stressful.

scenarios.context: A girl explains a stressful afternoon.

speakerA.en: Hi Mom. I had a terrible afternoon. I lost my phone at the park.
About an hour later. I looked everywhere, but I couldn't find it.
Yes, I asked a woman at the ice cream shop. She said someone gave a phone to the guard.
It was! I was so relieved, I almost cried.

speakerB.en: Oh dear. When did you notice?
Did you ask anyone for help?
And was it yours?
You were lucky. Next time, keep it in your zipped pocket.

scenarios.context: A boy tells his cousin about an unexpected visitor.

speakerA.en: Listen to this, Hadi. Yesterday someone knocked at the door at midnight.
A little. I opened the door slowly, and it was my uncle from Canada!
No, he wanted to surprise us. We hadn't seen him for five years.
We hugged him and made tea. We talked until three in the morning.

speakerB.en: At midnight? Were you scared?
No way! Did he tell you he was coming?
That's an amazing surprise. What did you do?
What a great story! I wish I had been there.

scenarios.context: A student describes a chance that changed her week.

speakerA.en: Sara, you look so happy. What's the news?
And she chose you?
How did the day go?
That's wonderful. It will look great on your school record.

speakerB.en: Last week my teacher called me after class. She said the school needed a student guide for visitors.
Yes! She said my English was good enough. It was a big opportunity for me.
I was nervous at first, but then I enjoyed it. The visitors asked me many questions.
I hope so. I learned that saying yes to new things can really help you grow.
